schema_notes.budget: training rows actually fit on (gradient steps / tree splits), always drawn from the non-dev pool for variant=='encoded17'/'raw10_bonus' rows
schema_notes.dev_size: rows used for early stopping / best-checkpoint selection in this fit (0 for variant=='full_budget_no_early_stop', which touches no dev rows at all)
schema_notes.labels_seen: budget + dev_size: every label this fit's pipeline actually read
schema_notes.fit_iterations: epochs (MLP) or boosting rounds (xgboost/lightgbm) actually used at prediction time
schema_notes.early_stopped: whether fit_iterations was chosen by dev-loss early stopping (True) or fixed in advance (False, full_budget_no_early_stop rows only)

rows.note: trains on 90% of one random half of the test file (internal_fit), early-stops on the other 10% of that same half (internal_dev), evaluates on the other half of the test file entirely (big_eval_idx, disjoint from both) - NOT part of the fair label-budget comparison, since it uses test-file labels for training by construction; reported only to show the asymptotic ceiling a trained baseline reaches with far more labels than the 25,010-row training file provides. See rare_class_split_detail for exact straight_flush/royal_flush counts in each of the three disjoint sets.
